parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: SharePromotionActivityId
parameters.description:
The ID of the promotional activity.

This is the **Data** value returned by the **CreateSharePromotionActivity** operation.

parameters.name: ShareTaskCode
parameters.description:
The share code of the sharing task.

For more information about the share code, see [Use shared devices to broadcast shared voice content](~~607661~~).
